name: adr-writer
description: ADR-driven development cycle for Claude Code: author ADRs with /adr-new, implement them with /adr-impl, apply verified low-risk refactors with /adr-impl-refactor, review them, and keep them in sync with /adr-sync — with an ADR-first hook that injects the admission directive when session context starts or is restored. Works standalone; no ALPS PRD required.
